people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Kish
people.line: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Zela
people.line: A city in Benjamin where Saul's family was buried

translations.web: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
translations.bsb: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in Zela in the land of Benjamin, in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish. After they had done everything the king had commanded, God answered their prayers for the land.
translations.kjv: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
translations.asv: And they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.
